args.narrative: The direct positional values and gated corrections add in the logit before the sigmoid produces predicted x-win probability. Their combined nonlinearity matters: replacing the switching gates by least-squares affine fits on the training rows changes AUC from {{q:q_9c824faecf.auc_full|.4f}} to {{q:q_9c824faecf.auc_all_affine|.4f}}. This does not identify which game tactics they represent. On the {{q:q_b16d796df5.subgroup.n|d}} training positions with an open three-o line pattern and a blank completion square, the observed x-win fraction is {{q:q_b16d796df5.subgroup.outcome_rate|pct}} while mean predicted x-win probability is {{q:q_b16d796df5.subgroup.mean_predicted_risk|pct}}. The pattern definition does not require gravity support for the blank square. The dataset excludes forced-next-move positions; this subgroup is not a test of detecting an immediate winning move. In the constructed bottom-c-square edit, the whole-model predicted x-win probabilities for o, blank and x are {{q:q_9ee81a792f.rows[0].risk|pct}}, {{q:q_9ee81a792f.rows[1].risk|pct}}, {{q:q_9ee81a792f.rows[2].risk|pct}}, respectively; this is an artificial coordinate edit, not a legal move sequence. The operation hierarchy is complete; maximum function-preservation error is {{q:q_238becbfd6.function_preservation_max_abs_err|.2g}}. The separate gate hypotheses remain descriptions rather than tactical explanations.

args.narrative: This subgroup selects open three-o line patterns with a blank completion square, irrespective of support below the blank. It is not an immediate-winning-move test. The dataset excludes forced-next-move positions. The stored count and probabilities are unchanged.
